title: Pricing Q&A — Charging Points Beyond the Included Count on Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Charging Points Beyond the Included Count

Questions answered on the part of an amended annual fee that is carried for metered points beyond the count a tier of Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions includes. The bulk point count is 3 points and the bulk step is 10 percent.

## Rule

Where the points the site meters do not exceed the points the tier includes, no charge is carried for points beyond the included count. Where the points beyond the tier's included count are more than the bulk point count, every point beyond carries the tier's meter overage fee less the bulk step. In every other case every point beyond the tier's included count carries the tier's meter overage fee.

## Questions

**How many points are beyond the included count?** The points the site meters, less the points the tier includes; where the site meters no more than the tier includes, there are none.

**A tier including 12 points where the site meters 12.** No charge at all is carried for points beyond the included count.

**A tier including 12 points where the site meters 15.** Three points are beyond, which is not more than the bulk point count of 3, so each of the three carries the tier's meter overage fee in full.

**A tier including 12 points where the site meters 16.** Four points are beyond, more than 3, so each of the four carries the tier's meter overage fee less 10 percent: at an overage fee of USD 150 a year, USD 135.00 for each of the four, that is USD 540.00.

## Table

| Points beyond the tier's included count | Charge carried |
|---|---|
| none | nothing |
| 1 to 3 | the tier's meter overage fee for each point beyond |
| 4 or more | the tier's meter overage fee less 10 percent, for each point beyond |
